# defectdojo_note_type (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo note type by ID or name. It needs a superuser or the note type configuration permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_note_type" "by_name" {
  name = "Code Review"
}

data "defectdojo_note_type" "by_id" {
  id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the note type to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the note type to look up, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the note type.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the type is offered for new notes.
- `is_mandatory` (Boolean) Whether, while the type is active, the UI requires a note of the type before a finding is closed, or set inactive or false positive.
- `is_single` (Boolean) Whether an object can have only one note of the type.
